name: io.github.rgf2004/pushpage
title: pushpage
description: Publish HTML from your AI agent and get a shareable link back.

environmentVariables.name: PUSHPAGE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Your pushpage API key (pp_...) from the dashboard. Without it the server runs in guest mode: publish_page works, pages expire after 30 minutes.

environmentVariables.name: PUSHPAGE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the pushpage instance. Defaults to https://pushpage.link.

headers.name: X-Api-Key
headers.description: Optional, for headless or CI setups only. Without it you can connect and publish right away as a guest (pages expire after 30 minutes), and a client that supports MCP sign-in opens your browser the first time you list, update or delete pages. Or paste your pushpage API key (pp_...) from the dashboard.
